pages.text: It is said that this book appears to be connected with an ancient library that stores everything that was physically written but no one could ever enter it.$(br) Although this book is rare it's not unique and can be found in some dungeons like $(l)Abandoned Mineshaft$() or $(l)Ancient City$().

Using it is actually very easy: I need to hold $(l)the codex$() in my $(l)main hand$() and in your $(l)second hand$() - a carving pattern that I want to rewrite. After that, open the codex and it will transform into a different pattern $(l)consuming one in my second hand$().
